description:
The fastest way I know to stop having boring conversations and become more magnetic:
https://bit.ly/004-26


Most people are stuck having the same boring conversations on repeat. They play it safe, ignore the obvious, and stay trapped in rigid social scripts that kill connection and charisma.

In this video, you’ll learn the conversation techniques Ryan Gosling uses to instantly make interactions more fun, magnetic, and memorable, so you can stop running out of things to say, connect faster, and become someone people genuinely love talking to.


0:00 - Intro
0:21 - Why conversations feel repetitive
1:10 - Escape the frame
2:07 - Follow the shiny thing
2:50 - Open the circle
4:22 - Imply friendship fast
4:46 - Acknowledge others emotions
7:00 - The fastest way to become more charismatic
